title: Basel group extended the DMT state to 90 minutes

tellings.quote: another group in Barzel Mata u Matias Leaki I think he's called uh has extended it for 90 minutes.

plain: A research group in Basel, Switzerland, has made the DMT experience last 90 minutes. DMT is a powerful psychedelic whose effects usually last only a few minutes. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore tells Michels this without naming a paper, crediting a researcher he thinks is called Matias Leaki, and he raises it because a longer trip would give people more time to explore the realm and the beings they say they meet there.
